mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 64 degrees under overcast skies at Badger Ridge Middle School with a Waning Gibbous moon above. Tonight, temperatures will drop to 46 degrees and we are expecting rain overnight.

Mayor Diaz has officially recognized October as Community Planning Month to thank the Planning and Development Department for their expertise in shaping our city. Also, please keep an eye out for mail regarding cross connection surveys to help keep our water supply clean.
Today features Yoga at Insight Wellness and the ART House 360 Happy Hour, along with Hop Haus Trivia. Tomorrow, enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company.
On September 21, officers identified and cited an individual for retail theft after they were caught on surveillance stealing Swedish Fish candy.
The flavor of the day is the delicious Turtle Cheesecake. Culver's is open until 10 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
